block.create_new_era.bearing_servo.toolt: Programs will set its _angle_ in degrees, for gimbals, turrets and flaps.
Turns an attached _contraption_ to an exact angle on command.
block.create_new_era.brass_computer.tool: Turns the computer. The sides turn with its _front_.
Takes a _shaft_ in its back. The _faster_ it spins, the faster programs run. Without rotation they _pause_ and carry on when it turns again.
Every face is a _side_: front, back, left, right, top and bottom. Read signals with _redstone.getInput_, send them with _redstone.setOutput_.
A program that was running _starts again_ from the top.
Runs _Lua_ programs you write in its built-in _editor_. They drive _redstone_ and, through _data ports_ and _cables_, the machines on the _data bus_.
block.create_new_era.brass_screen.toolti: Turns the screen. It joins whatever screens it now lines up with.
Screens facing the _same way_ merge into _one pane_ and the brass frame between them disappears.
_48 by 48_ flip pixels per block. Pick _square plates_ or _round discs_ in the client config.
Joins with its neighbours into one big display made of _flip pixels_ that turn when they change.
block.create_new_era.nixie_digit.tooltip: Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
_setDigit(n)_ shows 0 to 9, _setDigit(nil)_ turns it dark; _getDigit()_ reads it.
One glowing _digit_; place several in a row to show whole numbers.
block.create_new_era.panel_button.toolti: Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
_isPressed()_, and _onPress(fn)_ runs fn on every press. It pops back up after half a second.
A momentary _push button_ for programs to react to.
block.create_new_era.panel_gauge.tooltip: Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
_set(0.25)_ moves the needle a quarter of the way, from 0 to 1; _get()_ reads it.
A needle dial that shows any _value_.
block.create_new_era.panel_keypad.toolti: Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
_onKey(fn)_ runs fn(key) for every key pressed; _getKey()_ gives the last one.
Twelve keys to _type numbers_ into a program.
Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
_getValue()_ reads it, _setValue(n)_ turns it. Hold R-Click on it and drag the mouse sideways to turn it.
A rotary knob that dials in a value from _0 to 15_.
Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
An indicator light a program can switch and _colour_.
block.create_new_era.panel_slider.toolti: Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
_getValue()_ reads it, _setValue(n)_ slides it. Hold R-Click on it and drag the mouse sideways to slide it.
A fader for a value from _0 to 15_.
block.create_new_era.panel_switch.toolti: Sits on the face you click: _floors, walls or ceilings_. Put several together to build a _control desk_.
_isOn()_ reads it; _setOn(b)_ flips it from a program.
An _on/off_ lever a program can read.
block.create_new_era.port_hub.tooltip.be: Click any of its sockets. Cables of _different colours_ still don't join through it; bare copper joins any.
block.create_new_era.port_hub.tooltip.su: Twenty-four data sockets, _four on every face_, all joined inside: where a network's cables meet.
block.create_new_era.universal_adapter.t: Sticks to the face you click, so it fits on _any side_ of a machine.
Not wired up yet: put a _Data Port_ on a block to bring it onto the bus.
Attach to any block to expose what it can do, _kinetics_, _items_ or _fluids_, on the data bus.
create_new_era.api.fluids.fluids: Each of its tanks: the fluid's id ("" when empty), how much is in it and how much fits, in mB.
create_new_era.api.items.count: How many of one item it holds, e.g. count("minecraft:iron_ingot").
create_new_era.api.items.items: Everything it holds: each item id with how many there are, across all its slots.
create_new_era.api.kinetic.getMaxValue: The highest speed it can be set to: 256 RPM.
create_new_era.api.kinetic.getMinValue: The lowest speed it can be set to: -256 RPM.
create_new_era.api.kinetic.getSpeed: How fast it turns, in RPM. Negative when it turns the other way; 0 when it's still or overstressed.
create_new_era.api.kinetic.getStress: Its network's stress: used is what the machines ask for, capacity what the sources give, both in SU.
create_new_era.api.kinetic.getTargetSpee: The speed it's set to, in RPM (a creative motor or a rotation speed controller).
create_new_era.api.kinetic.isOverstresse: True when its kinetic network asks for more stress than it has, so it's stopped.
create_new_era.api.kinetic.setSpeed: Sets the speed, from -256 to 256 RPM, like turning its value with the mouse wheel.
create_new_era.api.machine.read: Everything readable about it in one table: speed, overstressed, stress, items, fluids... whichever it has.
create_new_era.api.nixie_digit.getDigit: The digit it shows, or nil when it's dark.
create_new_era.api.nixie_digit.read: Its digit, or nil when it's dark.
create_new_era.api.nixie_digit.setDigit: Shows a digit from 0 to 9; nil turns it dark.
create_new_era.api.on_change: Runs your function every time the device changes, until the program stops. It's given value, then device. value is %s
create_new_era.api.on_key: Runs your function for every key pressed, with the key: "0" to "9", "*" or "#".
create_new_era.api.on_press: Runs your function each time the button is pressed down (not when it pops back up).
create_new_era.api.panel_button.isPresse: True while it's held down: half a second after each press.
create_new_era.api.panel_gauge.get: Where the needle is, from 0 (empty) to 1 (full).
create_new_era.api.panel_gauge.read: Where the needle is, from 0 to 1.
create_new_era.api.panel_gauge.set: Moves the needle: 0 is empty, 1 full, 0.5 halfway. It moves in sixteen steps.
create_new_era.api.panel_keypad.getKey: The last key pressed: "0" to "9", "*" or "#"; nil before the first.
create_new_era.api.panel_knob.getValue: Where the knob is set, from 0 to 15.
create_new_era.api.panel_knob.setValue: Turns the knob to a value from 0 to 15.
create_new_era.api.panel_lamp.set: Lights it "amber", "green" or "red", or turns it "off". true is amber, false off.
create_new_era.api.panel_slider.getValue: Where the handle is, from 0 (one end) to 15 (the other).
create_new_era.api.panel_slider.setValue: Slides the handle to a value from 0 to 15.
create_new_era.api.panel_switch.isOn: Which way the lever is: true for on.
create_new_era.api.panel_switch.setOn: Flips the lever from the program, as if a player had.
create_new_era.bus.computer_full: No ports left: a Port Expansion adds 4 more
create_new_era.bus.expansion_needs_compu: Port expansions go on a Brass Computer, up to 3
create_new_era.bus.no_room: No room for a port there
create_new_era.bus.port_now_in: Port set to input: programs can give this block orders
create_new_era.bus.port_now_out: Port set to output: programs can read this block
create_new_era.bus.use_sockets: The computer's own ports go in the sockets on its sides
create_new_era.cable.color_clash: That part already has cable of another colour
create_new_era.cable.no_route: No way along the faces between them
create_new_era.cable.not_enough: Needs %s m, the spool has %s m
create_new_era.cable.started: Cable started: click the other end (sneak to run it along faces)
create_new_era.cable.too_far: Too far to hang a cable (24 blocks at most)
create_new_era.configuration.screenPixel: Flip pixels on brass screens: square plates or round discs.
create_new_era.configuration.title: Create: New Era
create_new_era.editor.bad_name: Names can use letters, numbers, _ - . and /
create_new_era.editor.flows_soon: Coming soon: what moves between your machines and programs, live.
create_new_era.ponder.bearing_servo.head: Steering contraptions with the Bearing Servo
create_new_era.ponder.bearing_servo.text: The Bearing Servo carries a contraption on its rotor, like a Mechanical Bearing
Coming soon: instead of spinning, it turns to the exact angle a program asks for
create_new_era.ponder.brass_computer.tex: The Brass Computer runs programs written in Lua
It runs on rotational force through its back. The faster it spins, the faster programs run
Without rotation, or when overstressed, the program pauses and carries on later
Right-click it to open the editor. Write a program there, then press Run or Ctrl+R
Programs send redstone out of any side: redstone.setOutput("left", true)
Sides are named from the computer's front: front, back, left, right, top and bottom
While a program runs the screen lights up, and it keeps running when nobody is watching
create_new_era.ponder.brass_screen.text_: Brass Screens facing the same way join into one display
The brass frame between them disappears, so any rectangle reads as a single pane
Every block holds 48 by 48 flip pixels that turn over when they change. Square plates or round discs: pick one in the client config
Coming soon: programs will draw on them
create_new_era.ponder.panel_controls.tex: Panel controls sit on whichever face you click...
...tops, walls, even ceilings. Mix them to build a control desk
Coming soon: programs read buttons, switches, knobs, sliders and keypads, and drive lamps, nixie digits and gauges
create_new_era.ponder.tag.computing.desc: Computers, screens and panel controls for programming your contraptions
Universal Adapters stick to whichever face you click, on any block
Coming soon: each adapter puts the block it touches on the data bus, with its speed, stress, items and fluids
item.create_new_era.brass_port.tooltip.a: Sticks a port where you click. No mode to pick with the wrench.
item.create_new_era.brass_port.tooltip.s: A _data port_ in brass that does both jobs: programs can _read_ the block and _give it orders_ through the same port.
item.create_new_era.bus_port.tooltip.act: Sticks a port where you click.
Turns it between _input_ and _output_. _Sneak_ to take it off.
item.create_new_era.bus_port.tooltip.beh: The block _publishes_ what it's doing: programs can _read_ it.
The block _takes orders_: programs can _control_ it.
item.create_new_era.bus_port.tooltip.sum: A _data port_ for the bus. Sticks to _any face_ of _any block_, Create machines included, without changing how the block works.
item.create_new_era.cable_splice.tooltip: Sticks a splice where you click.
Joins cables _in the middle of a run_. Sticks to any face like a port, but it isn't a device.
Hangs a cable between them, up to _24 blocks_.
Runs it _flat along the faces_ in between instead. Red when they aren't joined.
Same dye on all four sides in a crafting grid. Cables of _different colours never join_: separate networks. Bare copper joins any.
Data cable on a reel. The bar is the _metres left_; an empty spool is wound again, not thrown away.
item.create_new_era.control_plate.toolti: Combine with a part, like a _lever_ or a _nixie tube_, to make a control.
item.create_new_era.port_expansion.toolt: Sticks the expansion where you click.
Stick it on a _Brass Computer_ for _4 more ports_. Up to 3 per computer.
